sourceCopy.name: Protein Calculator
sourceCopy.title: Protein Calculator Free | UsefulVerse
sourceCopy.description: Estimate a daily protein amount from body weight and your chosen factor. Free calculator, no account, computed in your browser.
sourceCopy.intro: Estimate grams of protein per day from body weight and a grams-per-kilogram factor you choose. Split the result across meals or compare it with an intake you enter.
sourceCopy.howQuestion: How do I calculate a daily protein amount from body weight?
sourceCopy.howAnswer: Convert body weight to kilograms, then multiply it by the grams-per-kilogram factor you choose. Divide that daily estimate by the number of meals for an even arithmetic split.
sourceCopy.privacyQuestion: Is my weight uploaded or saved?
sourceCopy.privacyAnswer: No. The calculation runs in this browser. Your weight and intake are not uploaded or saved by this tool.
howTo: Enter body weight and select kilograms or pounds.
Choose a grams-per-kilogram factor; 0.8 is shown as a general adult reference, not a personal prescription.
Optionally enter meals per day and your current daily intake, then calculate.

fields.gramsPerKg: Chosen factor (grams per kilogram per day)
fields.mealsPerDay: Meals per day for an even split
fields.referenceNote: 0.8 g/kg/day is the general adult Recommended Dietary Allowance reference from the National Academies. Needs differ by person. This calculator lets you choose a factor and does not prescribe one.
fields.accuracyNote: Arithmetic estimate only, not a diet plan or medical advice. Protein needs may differ with age, health, pregnancy, activity, and other factors. Ask a qualified clinician or dietitian about your needs. The per-meal value is an equal division, not a recommended meal target.
fields.dailyTarget: Daily amount from your selected factor

messages.calculated: Estimate calculated from your selected factor.
messages.checkInputs: Check the body weight, factor, meal count, and optional intake.
messages.exampleLoaded: Example loaded: 70 kg, 1.2 g/kg, 3 meals, and 80 g current intake.
messages.copyUnavailable: Copy is not available in this browser.

additionalFaqs.question: What does 0.8 grams per kilogram mean?
additionalFaqs.answer: It means multiplying body weight in kilograms by 0.8 to get grams per day. The National Academies lists 0.8 g/kg/day as the Recommended Dietary Allowance for adults; it is a general reference, not an individualized target.

additionalFaqs.question: Does this calculator tell me how much protein I personally need?
additionalFaqs.answer: No. It performs arithmetic with the factor you enter. Age, health, pregnancy, activity, and other circumstances can affect needs, so ask a qualified clinician or dietitian for personal guidance.

additionalFaqs.question: Is the amount per meal a recommended serving?
additionalFaqs.answer: No. It simply divides the selected daily estimate evenly by your meal count. Real meals do not have to contain equal amounts.
